gen_pw_add: create an IR for pointwise addition of two tensors using loop_tool read, add, and write nodes
gen_reduce_add: create an IR for a reduce-add operation that sums all elements of a tensor into a scalar
gen_mm: create an IR for matrix multiplication using loop_tool mul and add nodes with three dimension variables
rand_sched: generate a random loop schedule for a loop_tool IR by splitting and ordering loop variables
check_exec: execute a loop_tool LoopTree on CPU and CUDA backends and validate results against a reference
